response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), a AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM c) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total, c.total - a.avg_total AS above_average FROM c CROSS JOIN a WHERE a.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > a.avg_total

assumptions.assumption: "Passes the 75-dollar cutoff" means amount strictly greater than 75 (amount > 75); a line with amount exactly 75 is excluded.

The per-category total is SUM(amount - spent), which skips lines where amount or spent is NULL. The overall average is the mean of the non-NULL category totals. Lines with a NULL category form their own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff is inclusive, so lines with amount of 75 or more are kept (amount >= 75).
